aggregation_rule: No aggregation of repeated observations or different outcomes. Preprint and journal of the same study contribute once, using journal data.

approval.basis: Hand-authored teaching choices, not a real researcher approval or a live AI validation.

direction_rule: Treatment minus comparator for means, treatment versus comparator odds for binary completion. Do not pool the three teaching effects.

outcome_map.scale_rule: Use reported points; no within-study normalization.

outcome_map.direction: The event is successful task completion.
outcome_map.scale_rule: Extract events and total; do not substitute failure counts.

pairing_rule: Match Study_ID, Condition_ID and Outcome_Metric; exactly one treatment and one comparator. No external comparator or cross-study borrowing.

project.domain: fabricated teaching example; not empirical evidence
project.question: How does structured versus plain feedback change task outcomes in independent adult groups?
project.title: Synthetic feedback comparison

source_precedence: Journal report over a preprint of the identical printed Study-ID; contradictory reports require resolution, not automatic overwrite.
Printed arm result lines are authoritative for this fictional corpus.

unit.independent_unit: One adult independently assigned to one arm, with one final task outcome.
unit.row: One Study_ID x Condition_ID x Arm x Outcome_Metric.
unit.study: One printed Study-ID; preprint and journal reports can belong to the same study.

unresolved_policy: Keep eligible rows with null required statistics and a field-specific unresolved item; do not impute or count technical failures as decisions.
